categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in cloud computing and industry informatization services, providing full-stack enterprise-level cloud platforms and informatization services from IaaS, PaaS, DaaS to SaaS layers. Its business includes cloud computing services such as cloud product sales, cloud solution development, and cloud leasing, as well as industry informatization services based on customized system development and integration for sectors like government, public security, military, rail transit, finance, and education.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary core technologies including heterogeneous cloud resource management, software-defined networking, high-performance load balancing, cloud disaster recovery, container cluster services, and blockchain-as-a-service. It emphasizes original innovation and integration innovation in cloud computing across IaaS, PaaS, DaaS, and SaaS layers, with advanced capabilities in data lakes, knowledge graphs, AI, and secure multi-level data access. The company also develops industry-specific technologies such as BIM model processing and rail transit scheduling algorithms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are government agencies, public security departments, military, rail transit operators, financial institutions, and educational organizations. The company serves large-scale enterprises and public institutions, focusing on digital transformation and cloud adoption in these sectors. It has established significant market presence in 29 provinces and 7 major industry fields in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant revenue contributions from South China, Western China, East China, North China, Central China, and Northeast China regions. It has expanded its presence by establishing subsidiaries in Fujian and other provinces to deepen market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly as a midstream cloud computing service provider and industry informatization solution integrator. It develops and sells proprietary cloud software products, provides cloud infrastructure and platform services, and delivers customized IT solutions and system integration services to end customers, positioning itself between hardware providers and end-user enterprises.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically focused on the 'industry + cloud' model, the company invests heavily in R&D, emphasizing autonomous innovation in cloud computing, big data, and AI. Key R&D directions include developing a secure, efficient heterogeneous cloud operating system, container and edge cloud technologies, low-code development platforms, multi-modal data sharing, and intelligent digital twin solutions. The company also prioritizes integration with domestic chipsets and software ecosystems to support import substitution.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through direct sales of cloud products, customized cloud solution development and integration services, cloud leasing services, and industry informatization system development and maintenance. The company primarily uses a direct sales model via bidding and tendering, supplemented by limited distributor sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic private cloud platform and cloud service provider with strong capabilities in autonomous innovation and import substitution. It holds a competitive edge in serving government and large enterprise sectors with comprehensive cloud stacks and industry solutions. It is recognized as a leader in private cloud market competitiveness and has received multiple industry awards and certifications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 546.26 million, a 9.58% increase year-over-year, but recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 10.68 million due to increased costs and delayed project payments. Total assets were about RMB 1.87 billion, with a slight increase from the previous year. R&D investment accounted for 11.43% of revenue, reflecting a growth in innovation spending. The company maintains a stable asset base with ongoing investments in fixed assets and in-progress projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its proprietary, original innovation in cloud computing technology with high security and hardware neutrality, supporting a wide range of domestic chipsets and operating systems. It offers a full-stack cloud platform tailored to industry-specific needs, enabling rapid digital transformation for government and enterprise clients. Its integrated cloud-edge-end solutions and strong industry experience provide differentiated value through reliable, scalable, and secure cloud infrastructure combined with deep domain expertise.
